sources.purpose: Attestation among the country's resident population, not a claim of national linguistic origin; no incidence estimates used as selection weights.
Pinned Latin-script national surname list, source ordering retained after documented de-duplication/exclusions. Redistribution rights not established; data are research-only.
Hepburn-style passport romanization standard; source-observed macronless Latin forms retained without generating kanji readings or alternate transliterations.

sources.license: MIT repo; surname estimates from 名字由来net
sources.romanization: Source-attested Hepburn romaji used as published with initial capitalization; kanji used only for cross-source identity checks, never stored.

sources.romanization: First attested hiragana reading of each surname mechanically rendered with documented Hepburn kana/compound/geminate mapping; no inferred new readings. Comparisons fold ou/oo/oh long-vowel spelling variants to avoid equivalent duplicate Latin values. Derived Latin spellings need human review.
